record.question: Who is crowned as the Miss Universe 2018?
record.explanation: Answer A: Catriona Gray. The Miss Universe organization’s historical winners record identifies Catriona Elisa Magnayon Gray of the Philippines as Miss Universe 2018. Catriona Gray is therefore the matching printed choice. Historical/source note: 2018 pageant winner, not the current titleholder. Reference: https://www.missuniverse.com/the-legacy/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
